run_download_mugsy_per_segment: run the download script to fetch all ReInterHand Mugsy camera params and image masks for every capture ID
download_cam_params: download the camera parameters JSON file for a given ReInterHand capture ID from the S3 bucket
download_images_masks: download and decompress per-segment environment map tarballs for a given ReInterHand capture ID
review_capture_id_list: review the list of ten ReInterHand capture IDs used for Mugsy camera data downloads
review_name_list: review the mapping of capture IDs to their per-segment name lists for image mask downloads
